description: Hit-rate-matched control: compare the class I preference of Tyr-alphaB1 domains with His-alphaB1 domains of similar promiscuity
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

r = pd.read_csv("profaff_alphaB1_vs_classI_preference.csv")
Y = r[r.alphaB1=="Y"]; H = r[r.alphaB1=="H"]
lo, hi = Y.hit_rate.min(), Y.hit_rate.max()
Hm = H[(H.hit_rate >= lo-0.05) & (H.hit_rate <= hi+0.05)]
print(f"Tyr hit rates {lo:.2f}-{hi:.2f} (n={len(Y)});  hit-rate-matched His domains n={len(Hm)}")
print(f"matched His log2OR median {Hm.log2_OR_classI.median():.2f} "
      f"(IQR {Hm.log2_OR_classI.quantile(.25):.2f}-{Hm.log2_OR_classI.quantile(.75):.2f})")
print(f"Tyr log2OR {sorted(Y.log2_OR_classI.round(2))}")
u = stats.mannwhitneyu(Y.log2_OR_classI.values, Hm.log2_OR_classI.values, alternative="less")
print(f"Mann-Whitney Tyr < matched His: U={u.statistic:.1f}, p={u.pvalue:.4f}")
print(f"all 3 Tyr domains below the matched-His median: "
      f"{(Y.log2_OR_classI < Hm.log2_OR_classI.median()).all()}")
print(f"\nmatched His domains and their class I preference:")
print(Hm[["pdz","hit_rate","log2_OR_classI","frac_classI_binders"]].sort_values("hit_rate").to_string(index=False))
Hm.assign(group="His_matched").to_csv("profaff_hitrate_matched_His_control.csv", index=False)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.5,5))
ax.scatter(H.hit_rate, H.log2_OR_classI, s=20, c="0.72", edgecolor="none", label="His at alphaB1 (n=71)")
ax.scatter(Hm.hit_rate, Hm.log2_OR_classI, s=34, c="navy", label=f"His, hit-rate matched (n={len(Hm)})")
ax.scatter(Y.hit_rate, Y.log2_OR_classI, s=90, c="crimson", zorder=4, label="Tyr at alphaB1 (n=3)")
for _, q in Y.iterrows():
    ax.annotate(q.pdz, (q.hit_rate, q.log2_OR_classI), xytext=(7,-3),
                textcoords="offset points", fontsize=9, color="crimson")
ax.axhline(0, ls="--", c="0.35", lw=1)
ax.axhline(Hm.log2_OR_classI.median(), ls=":", c="navy", lw=1.3)
ax.annotate("matched His median", (ax.get_xlim()[1], Hm.log2_OR_classI.median()),
            xytext=(-6,4), textcoords="offset points", ha="right", fontsize=8, color="navy")
ax.set_xlabel("hit rate (fraction of tested peptides bound)")
ax.set_ylabel("log2 OR, S/T at P-2 among binders")
ax.set_title("Class I preference is weaker at Tyr-alphaB1 than at equally promiscuous His domains")
ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=9, loc="upper right")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
